radiusSource: Radius 72.7 +/- 5.3 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 5655: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 72.7 +/- 5.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 50,577,390 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
